title: APPROVAL OF ONE-YEAR CONTRACT EXTENSIONS AND ISSUANCE OF REQUEST
text:
[D. CONSENT ITEMS]
APPROVAL OF ONE-YEAR CONTRACT EXTENSIONS AND ISSUANCE OF REQUEST
